title: NEPA Electroporation of Emiliania huxleyi Cells
author: Inbal Nussbaum
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p4zdqx6

steps.title: Collect E. huxleyi cells
steps.instruction: Collect exponentially growing E. huxleyi cells via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3000 g for 3 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Wash the cells once and resuspend them in 384mM Sorbitol.

substeps.instruction: Adjust the final concentration to ~10^8 cells/ml.

steps.title: Prepare electroporation mixture
steps.instruction: Mix 150 ul of cells with 1–10 mg of (linearized) plasmid.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to an electroporation cuvette with a 0.2 cm gap.

steps.title: Perform electroporation
steps.instruction: Electroporate the cells using optimal conditions.

steps.title: Recover cells
steps.instruction: Immediately transfer the cells after electroporation into 4 mL of fresh media.

substeps.instruction: Incubate in nonselective medium in the growth room under low light for 16–20 h.

steps.title: Apply selection
steps.instruction: Apply selection to the recovered cells.
